caption: The drawing depicts three main objects arranged vertically on a plain, light background. On the left, there is a pair of elongated tongs with rounded, bulbous handles and a circular hinge near the top; the handles are shaded in gray tones, while the topmost part is colored in yellow-green. In the center, there is a close-up detail of the yellow-green finial or decorative top of one of the tools, showing its gradual transition to a gray base, with an adjacent scale in inches for size reference. On the right, there is a shovel-like tool with a matching yellow-green finial at the top of the handle, transitioning into a long gray handle and a broad, flared gray scoop at the bottom. Both inch scales at the bottom indicate the relative size of the objects, and the name "Hans Korsch" is written in the bottom left corner. The drawing uses shades of yellow-green and gray to render the objects with subtle three-dimensional shading on an off-white background.
title: Fire Shovel and Tongs
